# Pocket Funhouse asset provenance

This package copies the canonical Pocket Funhouse 0.1.1 assets from `the-mystery-of-locked-rooms` without modification.

- `src/assets/backdrop.png` — original generated theatrical cut-paper interior, 1536×1024; the canonical source records its built-in image-generation provenance in `plans/asset-generation.json`.
- `src/assets/title.ttf` — Fraunces, copied from the canonical licensed Stormglide font set; SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- `src/assets/body.ttf` — DM Sans, copied from the canonical licensed Stormglide font set; SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- Audio remains the same original in-code Web Audio synthesis: no downloaded recording is included.
- Tracks, shutters, reward symbols and other mechanism art are canvas geometry or Unicode, as in the canonical game.

The original font notices and the SIL Open Font License 1.1 are retained in
`Fraunces-OFL.txt` and `DM-Sans-OFL.txt`.
